test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 6% per annum rate of interest for the period from 19 February 2024 to 20 April 2024.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify **Time** in days: Feb (10) + Mar (31) + Apr (20) = 61 days (Note: 2024 is a **Leap Year**).

Apply direct SI calculation: (4000 × 6 × 61) ÷ (100 × 366).

Simplify: 40 × 6 × (61 ÷ 366) ⇒ 40 × 6 × (1/6) = 40.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/595780dbbba50e09d459196b3142ddfbba1a4ae3979293e826ee6d2649b477e1.png] 

**Given:**

Principal (P) = **₹4,000**

Rate (R) = **6% per annum**

Time Period: 19 Feb 2024 to 20 Apr 2024

Days in Feb = 29 − 19 = 10 days (**Leap Year**)

Days in March = 31 days

Days in April = 20 days

⇒ Total Days (T) = 10 + 31 + 20 = **61 days**

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ T in years = 61 ÷ 366 (As 2024 is a leap year)

⇒ SI = (4000 × 6 × 61) ÷ (100 × 366)

⇒ SI = (40 × 6 × 61) ÷ 366

⇒ SI = (240 × 61) ÷ 366

⇒ SI = 14640 ÷ 366

⇒ SI = 40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Leap Year Calculation

A year is a **leap year** if divisible by 4 (e.g., 2024). It has 366 days and February has 29 days.

Simple Interest on Days

While calculating days, the day the money is deposited is excluded, but the day the money is withdrawn is included.

Amount Formula

Total Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI).
